final: WITH category_averages AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS average_unit_price FROM Products GROUP BY production_type_code), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_unit_price) AS overall_average FROM category_averages) SELECT c.production_type_code, c.average_unit_price, c.average_unit_price - o.overall_average AS difference FROM category_averages AS c JOIN overall AS o ON o.overall_average IS NOT NULL WHERE c.average_unit_price > o.overall_average ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
